title: Supplemental Information 1: Core parallel scan implementation enabling efficient state computation for selective state space models in Mamba.

items.publisher: Institute of Electrical and Electronics Engineers (IEEE)
items.abstract: <jats:p>This study evaluates the training efficiency and scaling behavior of the Mamba Selective State Space Model (SSM). We implement a character-level language model trained on the TinyShakespeare dataset using JAX and the experimental Metal backend on an Apple M2 Pro. Our findings demonstrate near-perfect linear scaling (50.5%) when doubling model depth and identify critical hardware-constrained hyperparameter boundaries to prevent GPU buffer errors.</jats:p>
title: Implementation and Evaluation of Mamba Selective State Space Models for Shakespearian Text Synthesis
